title: Samsung set for record W100tr quarterly profit on memory boom
key_facts: Analysts compiled by FnGuide expect Samsung Electronics to report Q3 operating profit of 108.1 trillion won ($80.2 billion), nearly nine times a year earlier, on revenue of 201.7 trillion won.
It would be Samsung's first quarterly operating profit above 100 trillion won; the previous quarter was 89.4 trillion won.
Samsung releases preliminary earnings guidance on Thursday.
Memory (DRAM, NAND, high-bandwidth memory) drives the surge; Samsung's HBM market share rose to 33% in Q2 from 21% in Q1, per Counterpoint Research.
The foundry and System LSI units are expected to stay in the red; the DX consumer-devices division is expected to widen its loss.
quote_evidence: Samsung Electronics is poised to break the 100 trillion won mark in quarterly operating profit for the first time, as booming memory chip sales drive another record quarter.
The foundry and System LSI businesses are expected to remain in the red in the third quarter.
why_it_matters_hint: Memory makers are earning record profits from AI demand, but this is an analyst forecast until Samsung reports.
notes: Forecast, not a reported result. Preliminary guidance due Thursday 8 Oct.
